data.name: send slack message (template)
data.evaluateGuide:
Publishes a templated message to a Slack channel or direct conversation through Slack's message API. Use it when the destination and text are supplied in the endpoint URL.
Use for: Send templated text, post to a channel, notify a user
Not supported: Listing channels, editing messages, reading message history

data.name: Send a message to a channel using Slack
data.evaluateGuide:
Delivers a message to a Slack channel through an incoming webhook URL. Use it for simple webhook-based channel notifications.
Use for: Post a channel alert, send an automated notification, publish status text
Not supported: Listing channels, retrieving messages, managing users

data.name: slack-post-message
data.evaluateGuide:
Posts a message to a specified Slack conversation using Slack's chat message API. The endpoint supports sending content, not discovering destinations.
Use for: Send a channel message, post a trip update, publish an automated notification
Not supported: Listing channels, reading history, editing or deleting messages

data.name: slack-channels
data.evaluateGuide:
Retrieves Slack public and private channel resources through the conversations API. Use the response to discover available channels before posting.
Use for: List channels, find a channel identifier, discover private channels
Not supported: Sending messages, reading message history, creating channels

data.name: Send Slack Message via Channel
data.evaluateGuide:
Posts a message to a Slack channel through Slack's chat message API. Supply the destination and message payload to deliver channel content.
Use for: Send channel content, publish an alert, share an automated update
Not supported: Listing channels, retrieving history, managing channel membership

data.name: Check Answer and Send Result to Slack
data.description: Checks If User Answered Correctly or Not and Send the Result to Slack.
data.evaluateGuide:
Sends a trivia result to a Slack response URL after evaluating whether the user's answer is correct. It is designed for interactive Slack app responses.
Use for: Return quiz results, send correctness feedback, reply to an interaction
Not supported: General channel discovery, message history, user management

data.name: Send message to slack
data.evaluateGuide:
Posts a message to a Slack conversation through Slack's chat message API. Use it for automated notifications or updates delivered to a chosen destination.
Use for: Send a Slack message, publish an update, deliver an alert
Not supported: Listing conversations, reading history, editing messages

data.name: Send message to Slack bot
data.evaluateGuide:
Targets a Slack command endpoint using a POST payload, typically for handling or forwarding Slack slash-command interactions. Use it for command-driven bot flows.
Use for: Process a slash command, trigger a bot action, return command output
Not supported: Posting arbitrary channel messages, listing channels, reading history
